summary: Web frontend-only test of Milestone 3 follow-up: (A) /admin/feed-defaults page and (B) 3-dot per-card feed-controls menu on the design=new_look_v2 Social Feed. BOTH FEATURES PASS. Admin page loads with 7 category rows (person/friend/station/business/creator/advisor/club) each exposing 4 mode buttons (all_updates/daily_highlights/live_only/mute); Save fires success toast; PUT persists (verified via GET /api/social/feed-preferences/defaults after reload). Sidebar entry (AdminSidebar > Content > Feed Defaults, testid adnav-cq-feed-defaults) navigates to the page. On demo home ?design=new_look_v2, feed-v2 following returns ~20 items including Stella Moon's MOMENT; sf-card-menu-btn opens sf-card-menu containing sf-card-menu-mode-{all_updates,daily_highlights,live_only,mute} + sf-card-menu-manage; clicking daily_highlights fires PUT /api/social/feed-preferences/person/<id> (200) and a success toast 'Stella Moon · Daily Highlights'; sf-card-menu-manage navigates to /settings/feed.

issues: Save button is positioned at the top-right of the main content area but it visually floats over the sidebar/subnav region on narrower widths; harmless at 1920x1080 but worth a sanity check at ~1280px

critical_code_review_comments: AdminFeedDefaults.jsx: toast.error paths swallow the real error object (`catch (e)` unused). Consider surfacing status/body for easier admin debugging.

AdminFeedDefaults.jsx: active-state styling relies on inline rgb strings; adding a stable `data-active='true'` attribute on the mode buttons would make the UI robustly testable without parsing computed styles.

AdminFeedDefaults.jsx: `save` sends the full `defaults` object even when only one row changed — fine for admin volume but a reduced diff payload would avoid race-y overwrites if two admins edit concurrently.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend was already seeded by main agent (Stella Moon MOMENT within 7-day window).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /admin/feed-defaults full happy path (load → change → save toast → reload persists → reset). Sidebar link testid adnav-cq-feed-defaults works after expanding the 'Content' section in AdminSidebar. Backend PUT confirmed persisting (GET returns changed value). For the 3-dot menu, the social feed home at /?design=new_look_v2 renders ~20 cards with sf-card-menu-btn; menu contains all 4 mode options + sf-card-menu-manage link that goes to /settings/feed; mode click issues PUT /api/social/feed-preferences/person/<user_id> and fires toast. Note my first-pass UI active-state regex missed a space in 'rgb(168, 85, 247)' giving a false 'not persisted' result; actual persistence works — recommend adding data-active attributes for easier future testing.
